title: Robert S NDE 4454
content: Upon passing out in the shower I fell forward and struck my face between the eyes on a small retaining wall between the shower and bathroom floor. I experienced a view of myself from outside of the shower on the bathroom floor looking back into the shower at myself lying there. As I looked up, I could see an image of an individual in a glowing gown. The image was slowly raising upward. As I panned up further I saw a very bright silver/metallic like button in the middle of the chest of this robe/gown. The robe/gown was lightly illuminated and the button was laser like in the center of chest. I noticed that as I panned up further the image had its hands stretched out to the sides with the palms up. In the final pan upward, I saw myself with a smile on my face. The image continued to rise and was extremely peaceful. Immediately I experienced being above my prone body looking down at myself lying in the shower. Then it was over and I was awake looking at my wife who was actually there immediately after she heard the accident. It took me five days to process this information before I shared it with my wife. I remember being in the emergency room thinking about what I thought was so funny and why I had a smile on my face. I remember thinking what a smartass I was.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: View from outside of the shower on the bathroom floor looking back into the shower at himself lying there; then above his prone body looking down at himself in the shower.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described the rising image and the experience as 'extremely peaceful.'

arrival.other_being_detail: An 'image of an individual in a glowing gown' with a 'very bright silver/metallic like button' in the middle of the chest; hands stretched out to the sides with palms up; the image 'was slowly raising upward.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out in the shower, fell forward, and struck face on a retaining wall.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included a visual of a glowing-gowned individual rising upward with a bright silver/metallic 'button' at the chest; then an OBE above the body; then waking and seeing his wife.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE view from outside the shower looking back into the shower; visual encounter with glowing-gowned figure rising; then being above his body looking down; then waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The 'very bright silver/metallic like button' in the center of the glowing robe/gown described as 'laser like,' and the experiencer seeing himself 'with a smile' during the final upward pan.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I experienced a view of myself from outside of the shower on the bathroom floor looking back into the shower at myself lying there.”; “I could see an image of an individual in a glowing gown.”; “a very bright silver/metallic like button… laser like in the center of chest.”; “The image continued to rise and was extremely peaceful.”; “I remember being in the emergency room thinking about what I thought was so funny and why I had a smile on my face.”
